name: @graphrefly/native
description: GraphReFly Rust substrate (napi-rs bindings). NOT YET a drop-in substrate provider for @graphrefly/graphrefly: the napi surface is async-only (Core on a tokio blocking pool; sync calls deadlock — D070/D077) while @graphrefly/graphrefly consumes pure-ts's sync API. The install-time overrides drop-in (Q28/D198) is design-pending vs deferred D080 (async-everywhere public API). Today this package is consumed only by the parity-test harness.
comment_for_humans: Phase E (D074): @graphrefly/native is the napi-rs binding for the Rust GraphReFly dispatcher. The package.json shape mirrors the napi-rs canonical layout (binaryName + per-target sub-packages via optionalDependencies). For this slice, no platform sub-packages are published — the local build via 'pnpm build' produces graphrefly-native.<host>.node directly in this directory, which the workspace consumer (packages/parity-tests in graphrefly-ts) loads via relative file: dep. Cross-platform CI matrix lands in Commit 5 of this slice; npm publish is a separate release-engineering slice.
